# MobyGames — critic and player review index

- Original source: [MobyGames — critic and player review index](https://www.mobygames.com/game/7907/robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood/reviews/)
- Author / publication: MobyGames contributors; player review by Andrew Shepard
- Language / date: English; player review dated 2005
- Access: Live page blocked (HTTP 403); listing read from the Wayback Machine capture
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09, from the 2024-12-08 capture
- Archived copy: [Wayback Machine, 2024-12-08](https://web.archive.org/web/20241208020314/https://www.mobygames.com/game/7907/robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood/reviews/)
- Format: header notes, original summary, then the complete listing data

MobyGames provides another route into international reviews and player reception. The retrieved listing reports 37 critic ratings with an 81% average; alternate platform-filtered URLs expose different counts, so those numbers are not interchangeable.

The visible 2005 player review by Andrew Shepard enjoys the medieval setting and archery but complains about lengthy melee exchanges.

**Research use:** discovering additional contemporary publications and distinguishing critic scores from audience opinions. The player's description of the graphics as 3D should be treated as their wording, not a technical classification.

**Limitations:** dynamic counts and platform filters affect the aggregate. The listing was readable in indexed results, while opening the main game overview failed during this collection pass.

## Complete listing data

Retrieved from the Wayback Machine capture of 2024-12-08 (the live page returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients). Moby ID 7907. Alternative titles listed: Robin Hood: A Lenda de Sherwood, Die Legende von Sherwood, La Leggenda di Sherwood, La légende de Sherwood, Legenda Sherwood, Legenda Sherwoodu. Platform filters: Amiga, Linux, Macintosh, Windows.

- **Critic reviews:** average 81% based on 30 ratings in the 2024 capture (the earlier indexed figure of 37 ratings comes from a different date, so the counts drift).
- **Player reviews:** average 3.9 out of 5 from 19 ratings, 1 written review.
- The single player review, "Great Historical game, kind of struggling." by Andrew Shepard (Windows, 2005): bought a $5 copy; likes fighting Prince John's guards and the easy, fun bow; dislikes how long sword fights take and that both mouse buttons attack the same way; bottom line recommends it to fans of the medieval age who "love good 3D graphics" (the reviewer's wording).
- Critic entries were contributed by thirteen named MobyGames users; the individual publication rows were not present in the capture's HTML (they load separately), so they remain TODO.
